title: Computer Packages (Word, Excel, PowerPoint)
description: A practical beginner course for school leavers who want to use a computer with confidence at work or in a cyber café. You will learn file basics, Microsoft Word, Excel and PowerPoint (plus their free Google equivalents) and how to earn by typing and formatting documents for others.
outcomes: Organise files and folders and use common keyboard shortcuts
Type and format professional letters, CVs and reports in Word
Build spreadsheets with formulas, functions, sorting, filtering and charts in Excel
Create and present a clear slide show in PowerPoint
Do the same work for free in Google Docs, Sheets and Slides
Offer typing and document services to paying customers
